SELECT q.id AS quest_id, q.origin AS origin, q.published_version_id AS published_version_id, v.title, v.summary, v.description, v.cover_media_id, v.difficulty, v.estimated_minutes, v.distance_meters, v.price_stars, v.reward_stars, v.province_code, v.ward_code, v.safety_notes, v.content_language, v.amenity_tags, v.playable_months, v.run_expiry_hours, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quest_checkpoints cp WHERE cp.quest_version_id = v.id) AS checkpoint_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quest_checkpoints cp WHERE cp.quest_version_id = v.id AND cp.requires_checkin) AS required_checkin_count FROM quests q JOIN quest_creators c ON c.id = q.creator_id LEFT JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id = c.organization_id JOIN quest_versions v ON v.id = q.published_version_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quests q JOIN quest_creators c ON c.id = q.creator_id LEFT JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id = c.organization_id WHERE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quest_versions v WHERE v.id = q.published_version_id AND v.province_code = #{provinceCode}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quest_versions v WHERE v.id = q.published_version_id AND v.content_language = #{language})

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quest_versions ( id, quest_id, version, content_revision, change_kind, title, summary, description, cover_media_id, difficulty, estimated_minutes, distance_meters, amenity_tags, safety_notes, province_code, ward_code, content_language, price_stars, reward_stars, playable_months, playable_hours, run_expiry_hours, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{questId}, #{version}, #{contentRevision}, #{changeKind}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{description}, #{coverMediaId}, #{difficulty}, #{estimatedMinutes}, #{distanceMeters}, #{amenityTags}::jsonb, #{safetyNotes}, #{provinceCode}, #{wardCode}, #{contentLanguage}, #{priceStars}, #{rewardStars}, #{playableMonths}::jsonb, #{playableHours}::jsonb, #{runExpiryHours}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE quest_versions SET change_kind = #{changeKind}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, description = #{description}, cover_media_id = #{coverMediaId}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, estimated_minutes = #{estimatedMinutes}, distance_meters = #{distanceMeters}, amenity_tags = #{amenityTags}::jsonb, safety_notes = #{safetyNotes}, province_code = #{provinceCode}, ward_code = #{wardCode}, content_language = #{contentLanguage}, price_stars = #{priceStars}, reward_stars = #{rewardStars}, playable_months = #{playableMonths}::jsonb, playable_hours = #{playableHours}::jsonb, run_expiry_hours = #{runExpiryHours} WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quest_checkpoints ( id, quest_version_id, sort_order, name, latitude, longitude, radius_m, unlock_geometry, place_id, location_key, story, capture_source, capture_accuracy_meters, captured_at, requires_checkin, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{questVersionId}, #{sortOrder}, #{name}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{radiusM}, CASE WHEN #{unlockGeometryWkt} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ST_Multi(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText(#{unlockGeometryWkt}), 4326)) END, #{placeId}, #{locationKey}, #{story}, #{captureSource}, #{captureAccuracyMeters}, #{capturedAt}, #{requiresCheckin}, #{createdAt} )
